mechanic.name: investigator locomotion presentation
mechanic.build: task-16 Higgsfield player and motion upgrade

goal: Make walking and stopping readable through a coherent public-safe player character and Idle/Walk animation without changing movement speed, collision, focus, interaction, save data, or canonical state.

baseline.capture: Existing Web gameplay capture plus player engineering snapshot and source trace.
observations: The public Web build uses a procedural capsule because the local Mixamo lane is intentionally excluded.
The local Mixamo fallback plays only its first clip and does not switch on movement state.
Movement already emits movement_state_changed and distance-paced footstep signals while the camera bob shares the same stride cadence.

response_chain.evidence: WASD expresses directional movement while world interaction remains on E.
The existing physical-key InputMap feeds Input.get_vector without changing the proposal router.
Velocity, acceleration, deceleration, gravity, collision, and fall recovery remain the trusted movement path.
Player rig and locomotion animation are absent from canonical state and the terminal hash must match the control.
The curated 15,463-triangle rig exposes measured Idle (4.033333 s) and Casual_Walk (4.233333 s) clips; smoke and browser captures verify rest-to-walk switching.
The 12/12 presentation evaluation and full browser route show walk animation, alternating footsteps, and stride-locked camera feedback driven by the same movement state.
The extended 8/8 public-safe smoke check verifies walk-to-idle recovery and the unchanged terminal state hash after fall recovery.

primary_hypothesis.weak_link: public player readability and locomotion-state continuity
primary_hypothesis.problem: The capsule communicates position but not an investigator identity, while the local rig remains visually static during movement.
primary_hypothesis.change: Load one tracked Higgsfield-generated humanoid GLB in public-safe builds and cross-fade only between its Idle and Casual_Walk clips from the existing movement-state signal.
primary_hypothesis.expected_signal: Matched captures show a recognizable harbor investigator at rest and a visibly distinct walk cycle while route timing and terminal canonical hash remain unchanged.
primary_hypothesis.falsifier: The character clips, faces backward, slides excessively, obscures the interaction view, exceeds the Web asset budget, or changes any authoritative state or route result.
primary_hypothesis.competing_explanation: Weak movement feel may come from camera framing or footstep timing rather than the character model.

channels: subtle camera bob where motion is enabled
event_channels.necessary_information: The investigator is moving under player input.
event_channels.accessibility_alternative: The world translation and footstep sound remain available; reduced motion removes decorative camera sway but not necessary locomotion state.

event_channels.necessary_information: The investigator is planted and ready to inspect or choose.
event_channels.accessibility_alternative: Stable pose and stopped world translation communicate rest without sound.

safety.simulation_truth: WALK_SPEED, acceleration, deceleration, gravity, collision capsule, focus radius, interaction routing, save schema, quest rules, and canonical transforms remain unchanged.
safety.input_policy: No binding, buffering, pointer-lock, dialogue-lock, or additional fall-recovery rule changes; the existing D-048 local recovery is preserved.
safety.return_to_rest: Idle is restored after stop, input lock, fall recovery, or missing clip; missing/corrupt assets fall back to the procedural capsule or local rig.
safety.multiplayer_authority: Not applicable; the slice is offline and every world mutation still routes through the canonical proposal machine.

settings.behavior: The camera rests and animation transitions become immediate while necessary character locomotion continues.
settings.persistence: Use the existing M toggle and presentation director state.

settings.behavior: Muted play retains visible world movement and character animation.
settings.persistence: Use the existing V toggle and audio state label.

accessibility.redundant_signals: Movement and rest remain distinguishable without animation, camera motion, or audio as the sole channel.

comparison.control: Current public Web build with procedural capsule and current movement constants.
comparison.variant: Same build with only the curated player GLB, animation-state binding, and UI presentation changed.
matched_conditions: same canonical scenario and save schema
same golden-path route and interaction sequence
comparison.repetition_basis: Verify startup, idle, movement, stop, dialogue lock, fall recovery, missing-asset fallback, reduced motion, and the complete ending route.
acceptance: Idle and Casual_Walk are visibly distinct and return to rest after stop or lock.
The procedural capsule fallback still completes smoke when the generated asset is removed from a staged copy.
The public-safe and fallback runs produce the same terminal canonical hash.
The Web build and browser golden path reach the English completion card without new script, console, or page errors.

performance.budgets: Use the existing project-owned Web frame, PCK, draw-call, and memory review surfaces; this contract does not invent new thresholds.
performance.basis: Compare staged builds and engineering snapshots against the current public-safe control.
performance.measurement: Record GLB bytes, clip list, imported node counts, output PCK delta, browser console errors, and the available frame/latency receipts.

decisions.decision: Use Higgsfield native image-to-3D rigging and animation for the shippable player, retaining Mixamo only as a local fallback.
decisions.basis: Higgsfield output may be used commercially and tracked, while Adobe permits games but forbids raw Mixamo character or animation redistribution in this public repository.

decisions.decision: Bind animation to the existing movement_state_changed signal instead of creating a second locomotion state machine.
decisions.basis: The existing signal already owns the observed moving/rest transition and preserves one source of truth.

route_out.next_owner: Godot player presentation implementation and Web verification
route_out.reason: The controlled change, fallback, authoritative boundary, accessibility behavior, and acceptance evidence are frozen.
